version.label: HarvestStat version
version.description: Forecasts from CAPE models trained on HarvestStat Africa subnational crop statistics.

_comment: The crop / season / forecast month selectors are driven entirely by manifest.json,
which CAPE_crop_yield_forecast_visualization_harvestat.py regenerates on every run by scanning
the figure tree. Nothing in this file needs editing when a new forecast month lands.
What IS edited here is the narrative: each region has a default summary and set of
caveats, and 'notes' overrides them for specific combinations. A note matches when
every field it specifies (crop, season, month, year) matches the current selection;
fields it leaves out are wildcards, and the most specific matching note wins.
A note may set 'summary', 'caveats' (replaces the region list) and/or 'extraCaveats'

seasonNotes.Annual: Kenya and Tanzania are reported as a single Annual season in HarvestStat.
seasonNotes.Annual-Gu: Kenya and Tanzania (Annual) together with the Somalia Gu season (March-July).
seasonNotes.Annual-Deyr: Kenya and Tanzania (Annual) together with the Somalia Deyr season (October-February).
seasonNotes.Annual-Gu-Main: Kenya and Tanzania (Annual), the Somalia Gu season and the Sudan Main season, which are all forecast in these months.
seasonNotes.Main-Wet: The main West Africa rainy season, named Wet in Nigeria and Main elsewhere.
seasonNotes.Annual-Main-Summer: The same southern Africa summer season, named Main, Summer or Annual depending on the country.

regions.name: East Africa
regions.summary: Machine learning based sub-national crop yield forecasts for East Africa, trained on HarvestStat Africa data. Select a crop, season and forecast month above to view the corresponding maps.
caveats: Crop yield forecasts are masked for administrative units where historical Mean Absolute Prediction Error (MAPE) is above 40% and percent crop area (as per IFPRI crop mask) is at least 1%.
We provide absolute yield forecasts as well as anomalies relative to the observed crop yield baselines shown below.
These forecasts come from CAPE models trained on HarvestStat Africa yield data and use HarvestStat administrative boundaries, so units and results can differ from the FDW version of this page.

When countries in a region are forecast for different harvest years in the same month (for example Sudan and Tanzania in September), each harvest year is listed separately in the forecast month selector.
